newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices unchanged at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices unchanged at lower levels.

text.p: Indian cotton prices were quiet at the lower level on Monday while Gujarat varieties suffered some fresh losses, dealers said.
Punjab cotton met with some mill demand while Gujarat varieties extended losses on the back of rising new crop arrivals, one dealer said.

In spot deals Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,475/1,550 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) for the average variety and at 1,600/1,620 for the superior one. Bengal-deshi was unchanged at 840/870. Long-staple Gujarat Sankar-4 fell by 400/500 to 17,000/17,500 and to 18,000/18,500 for both types.
Closing sentiment remained subdued as traders expected higher new crop arrivals to come in this week.
